[EN] "Okay."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."

[EN] "The decryption is taken care of."
[ES] "El descifrado está listo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Decryption Device on the cryptographs and deliver the decrypted message to Padraig.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Tezluar in the Cardovek Remnants and kill him.

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It is done. The defense shield is active.
[ES] Está hecho. El escudo defensivo está activo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do my best."
[ES] "Haré mi mejor esfuerzo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
